purpose: Final G Theory validation of the GeneralizIT 0.1.2 adapter (Henderson Method I, balanced random facets). Committed before any numerical comparison.
inventory_finding: GeneralizIT rounds T (uncorrected sums, design.py:197), variance components and coefficients to 4 decimals. Observed before this protocol: p x i x r fixture x0.01 gives rho^2 1.0000 instead of 0.9943; x0.001 raises an uninformative error. Coefficients must be invariant to affine score changes.
fix: adapter fits the library on z = (y - mean(y)) * k with k = 10^m the smallest power of ten such that var(z) >= 1e8; components and error variances are divided by k^2; coefficients unchanged; k and the centering are recorded in settings. Exact by shift invariance and k^2 scaling of random-effects ANOVA components. Library rounding then affects at most ~5e-13 of the score variance.

references.B: R stats::aov expected-mean-square identities, validation/generalizability/reference.R (R 4.3.3), rounding emulation removed: raw components, coefficients from max(component, 0)
references.C: gtheoryr 0.2.0 sourced from the CRAN GitHub mirror cran/gtheoryr commit 3b53991557bfe2046119d37bf028a4647faedc18 (MIT; CRAN binary not installable on R 4.3.3); functions gstudy_pxi, gstudy_pxif, dstudy_pxi, dstudy_pxif

derived: the same fixture with score -> 100 + 0.001*score (affine invariance case)

outputs: universe, relative and absolute error variance
D study at x1 and x2 facet counts

gtheoryr_comparable.p x (r:i): NOT COMPARABLE (gtheoryr nests items within persons)

tolerances.variance_and_error_variance: |diff| <= 1e-9 * max(1, max|reference component|) (library 4-dp rounding at var(z) >= 1e8 contributes <= ~1e-12 relative)
tolerances.coefficients: |GeneralizIT 4-dp coefficient - unrounded reference| <= 5e-5 + 1e-9 (library display rounding only)
tolerances.gd_identity: D-study coefficients at original counts equal G-study coefficients exactly; error variances within 1e-12 relative
tolerances.affine: coefficients identical; components scale by b^2 within 1e-9 relative
tolerances.sem_budget: SEM = sqrt(error variance); budget rows sum to error variance within 1e-12 relative
tolerances.gtheoryr_coefficients: compared only when all raw components >= 0, because gtheoryr does not truncate negatives; otherwise NOT COMPARABLE

acceptance: a design x output is NUMERICALLY VALIDATED only if every executed reference comparison is within tolerance on these fixtures; a missing or skipped reference is NOT VALIDATED; any out-of-tolerance value is FAIL. Fixture-level only; status shown in the app remains LIBRARY TESTED, never CERTIFIED.
unsupported: fixed facets, unbalanced/missing/replicated data, (p:r) x i and other designs, F/p, coefficient CIs, bootstrap, cost optimization
compute_budget: local deterministic runs < 10 min; one full regression in CI; no Monte Carlo/bootstrap
